##### Project general facts

Arib Collection by ARIB Developments is a contemporary residential building that blends elegance, comfort and functionality. A modern facade with crisp, clean lines gives the architecture a refined and timeless character, while the building rises from a ground floor to eight residential floors. The collection offers a carefully curated selection of studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, with selected two-bedroom layouts including an additional room suitable for a study or home office.

Residents enjoy a rooftop swimming pool and a family pool with relaxation areas, a fully equipped gym and a padel court for an active routine. A clubhouse, a meeting area and co-working spaces support those working from home, while a children's playground, landscaped gardens and a barbecue and dining area create welcoming places to unwind and meet neighbours. A welcoming lobby, lifts and parking add everyday convenience for residents and their guests.

Interiors create a warm and comfortable atmosphere through a skilful combination of natural materials, a calm colour palette and thoughtful space planning. Bright, spacious apartments are fitted with everything needed for comfortable living, with high-quality finishes and equipped kitchens throughout. Homes are delivered fully furnished, offering a ready-to-move-in solution for owner-occupiers and a turnkey option for investors seeking immediate rental income.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubailand Residence Complex is a growing residential community in Dubailand, set close to Academic City and Al Ain Road, with a mix of mid-rise apartment buildings, landscaped spaces and community retail. Supermarkets, cafes, clinics and schools serve residents nearby, while the calm streets and accessible prices make the area popular with young professionals, students and families seeking a practical address.

Al Ain Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport. Dubai Outlet Mall is a short drive away, Hamdan Sports Complex and Dubai Safari Park are close by, and Meydan Racecourse, Downtown Dubai and The Dubai Mall are within comfortable reach, along with Dubai Silicon Oasis and Global Village.

Dubailand Residence Complex is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the more accessible entry points to the Dubai property market. Fully furnished studios and one-bedroom homes appeal to tenants from nearby universities and business hubs, supporting steady rental demand. Competitive entry prices, a flexible post-handover plan and improving infrastructure underpin attractive yields and long-term value for owners.
